packageRules.description: bincode 3.0.0 is a tombstone release: its entire lib.rs is a single compile_error!(). Upstream development has ceased and 3.0.0 was published only to signal that status, so no 3.x will ever build.

cosmic-text is pinned to a commit on hecrj's experimental `dev` branch rather than the default branch. The orbital-iced fork depends on unreleased APIs from that branch (cosmic_text::SpanPadding, LayoutGlyph::{ascender,descender}), so a digest "update" to the default branch is really a backwards downgrade that does not compile.
